senses.gloss:
1. जभ् or जम्भ् (cl. 1. जभते or जम्भ्˚, Dhātup. x, 28; aor. Subj. जम्भिषत्)
to snap at (gen.), RV. x, 86, 4 :
Caus. जम्भ॑यति (p. ˚यत्) to crush, destroy, RV.; AV.; VS. xvi, 5 :
Intens. जञ्जभ्य॑ते (and ˚भीति, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 86; p. भ्य॑मान [TS. ii, 5, 2, 4; Nyāyam.; Jaim., Sch.], ˚भान [Kauś. 114], ˚भत् [ŚāṅkhŚr. iv, 20, 1]) opening the jaws wide, snapping at (implying blame, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 24) cf. अभि- and √ जृम्भ्.
2. जभ् or जम्भ् cl. 1. जभति or जम्भ्˚ Ā. (Vop.) जभते (aor. अजम्भिष्ट), v.l. for √ यभ् (Dhātup. xxiii, 11) to know carnally, BhP. iii, 20, 26 (inf. जभितुम् v.l. यभ्˚).
जभ्य m. ‘snapper’, a kind of animal destructive to grain, AV. vi, 50, 2 (voc.)
जभ्य n. impers. the mouth is to be opened wide, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 61, Kāś.
